close_reason: Upstream issue/PR already filed and merged by Luke Valenta as RustCrypto/formats#1965 (commit 6e6ed032, 2025-07-26). Fix ships in x509-cert 0.3.0-rc.2+, not in any 0.2.x stable. No new upstream filing needed. Workaround removal is gated on the workspace bumping to x509-cert 0.3.x stable and is tracked as follow-up bead PKIX-rb6n. In-source comment updated to point at the upstream PR so future maintainers know the removal trigger.
description:
## Why

`x509_cert::Certificate::load_pem_chain` panics with subtract-with-overflow
at `certificate.rs:256` when given empty or whitespace-only input:

```rust
while position < input.len() - 1 {  // panics if input.len() == 0
```

Hit during PKIX-lhm4 (pkix-truststore). Worked around in `pkix-truststore`
by pre-checking for the `-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----` boundary before
delegating to `load_pem_chain`.

## What

Upstream fix: replace the subtract with `position + 1 < input.len()` or
`input.is_empty()` early return.

## Acceptance

- [ ] File an issue at RustCrypto/formats once we've confirmed it still
      reproduces on the latest x509-cert release.
- [ ] When fixed upstream and a new release lands, the workaround in
      `pkix-truststore/src/lib.rs::from_pem` (the empty-input guard with
      its rationale comment) can be removed and the `BEGIN_BOUNDARY`
      const deleted, but only after the workspace bumps `x509-cert` to
      the fixed version.

## Notes

Repro:
```rust
let _ = x509_cert::Certificate::load_pem_chain(b"");
// thread panics at 'attempt to subtract with overflow'
```

Affected: x509-cert 0.2.5 (and likely 0.3.0-rc.4; not confirmed yet).
title: x509-cert 0.2.5 load_pem_chain panics on empty input (upstream)
